entries.summary: Initial release: [oha_account_dashboard] shortcode replaces UWP iframe hack on /haunt-profile/ page
entries.notes: Profile card with avatar, display name, username, member status badge. Account actions card: Edit Account, Change Password, Privacy Settings, Track Orders (conditional on WC orders). Membership card (shown only if oha_member_id exists): status, member since, renews/expired date, member ID. Three-context CSS: PWA mode (floating cards, 58px touch targets, sticky tab nav), mobile web (<768px), desktop (>=768px). UWP profile chrome overrides: dark tab bar, hide cog button, hide profile header in PWA mode.
